page_title: 1.1.1.1 — The free app that makes your Internet faster.

sources.entry: Cloudflare WARP - Secure network service that routes traffic through Cloudflare. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: 1.1.1.1 with WARP
summary.one_liner: A free app from Cloudflare that encrypts traffic leaving your device and routes it through Cloudflare's network to improve privacy and speed.
use_cases: Hide browsing activity from your internet service provider
Encrypt traffic on a phone's internet connection
Improve browsing speed by connecting to a nearby Cloudflare data center
Protect remote workforce devices with Cloudflare Gateway
summary.what_it_does: The page describes WARP as a replacement for the connection between a device and the Internet, using a newer optimized protocol. It encrypts more of the traffic leaving the device so that an internet service provider cannot see which sites and apps are used. WARP+ subscribers get access to a larger network of cities, which the page says can reduce latency and improve browsing speed. The page also says WARP is built on the same network as the 1.1.1.1 DNS resolver. Business customers can integrate WARP with Cloudflare Gateway to enroll user devices.
notable: Encrypts more device traffic so ISPs cannot see visited sites and apps
Built on the same network as the 1.1.1.1 DNS resolver
WARP+ adds a larger network of connection cities for lower latency
caveats: WARP+ is a paid tier that unlocks the larger network
Business features require integration with Cloudflare Gateway
